The brand encourages joining both the hardware and software programs. No percentage is published here either. The brand's own site also publishes contact@infinityflow3d.com on its product pages, and its refund policy names the company as Infinity Flow 3D Printing LLC; Purdue University's engineering site documents the company as founded by Purdue alumni from a senior design project, and FlowQ is described on the brand's site as developed and hosted in the United States.
